changelog: Hotfix v3.3.1: Completely restored seamless authentication and login functionality across all workstations.
Removed experimental app monitor background service to guarantee maximum performance, rock-solid stability, and zero login issues.
WhatsApp Status Ticks Overhaul: Past messages and answered conversation messages accurately display WhatsApp Double Green Ticks (✓✓). Delivered cloud messages display Double Grey Ticks (✓✓).
Message Info & Read Receipts: Full delivery receipts and read participants with exact timestamps.
Enterprise Role Standardization: Streamlined all company structures to 4 strict roles: Founder, CEO, Manager, and Employee.
Strict Attendance Access: Attendance telemetry, member filtering, and ledger exports restricted strictly to CEO and Founder.
Author-Only Message Deletion: Strict author validation ensures users can only delete their own chat messages across cloud and local storage.
Real-Time Online Presence Fixes: Seamless live presence synchronization across Direct Messages, Team Members, and Chat header.
Secure Boot Screen & Auth Guard: Shielded workstation startup with authenticated boot screen, preventing unauthenticated sessions or fake ID message broadcasting.
